meta.name: steppe_horde_camp
meta.prompt: A nomad horde's camp on the open steppe: rings of felt yurts around the khan's great tent, horse lines and a wooden watch tower, the grass stretching to every horizon.

programs.brief: The Khan's colossal royal ger pavilion: a vast circular domed felt tent raised on an ornamental timber dais, adorned with horsetail war standards, patterned felt embroidery, and a grand smoke-ring crown.

tokens.terrain: vast flat open steppe with unbroken grassland stretching to every horizon
tokens.icons: khan's great tent on a central dais; concentric rings of felt gers and yurts; wooden watchtower overlooking the plain; horse picket lines; ovoo cairn and horsetail standards
tokens.infra: circular beaten cart_track ring roads between the yurt rings; horse picket lines around the camp perimeter
